### 5. **Most Common ATS Integration Categories**

Across all major ATS platforms, the core integration categories are:

| Category | Examples | Notes |
|----------|----------|-------|
| **Job Boards** | LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter, Google Jobs, Stack Overflow Jobs, AngelList | Globally available; most critical integration |
| **Communication** | Slack, Microsoft Teams, Email sync | Highly common; used for candidate updates and team notifications |
| **HRIS/Payroll** | BambooHR, Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, ADP, Oracle HCM | Essential for hired candidate data transfer |
| **Calendar/Scheduling** | Google Calendar, Outlook/Office 365, Calendly | Interview scheduling automation |
| **Assessment/Screening** | Plum, TestGorilla, Covey (AI-powered), Equip | Pre-hire skill/culture assessment |
| **Background Checks** | HireRight, Checkr, Certn | Post-offer verification |
| **Video Interview** | VidCruiter, Jobma (part of hiring suite) | Asynchronous candidate screening |
| **API/Webhooks** | Most platforms (Workable, Greenhouse, Lever) | For custom integrations and real-time data sync |

### 6. **Regional Availability vs Global**

**Globally Available:**
- LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, Google Calendar, Slack
- Most major HRIS platforms (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, ADP, BambooHR)
- AWS/Zapier ecosystem for custom integrations

**Regional/Specific:**
- [Europe/EMEA](https://integrations.greenhouse.com/t/job-distribution/job-boards): Local job boards integrated via platforms like [dstribute.io](https://dstribute.io/job-boards/dstribute-io-expands-ats-integrations-what-this-means-for-recruiters-in-2025/)
- [Asia-Pacific](https://www.mokahr.io/articles/en/the-best-ats-with-local-job-board-integration): TalentAdore, regional boards
- **Localization Support**: MokaHR and similar platforms offer multi-language, currency, and formatting support per region

### 7. **What's Realistic for a Resume Ranking Tool**

For Rankora as a resume ranking tool, the most realistic integrations would be:

**Tier 1 (Essential - Build First):**
- **API/Webhooks** for ATS connectivity (similar to how [Indeed integrates with 350+ ATS platforms](https://www.indeed.com/hire/ats-integration))
- **Zapier/Make** integrations for workflow automation without native code
- **CSV import/export** for job postings and candidate data

**Tier 2 (High Value - Build Next):**
- **LinkedIn API** for job posting sync
- **Indeed ATS Sync** integration
- **Slack webhook** for scoring notifications
- **Email webhooks** for candidate submission automation

**Tier 3 (Nice to Have - Future):**
- Direct HRIS integrations (Workday, BambooHR) — but typically the ATS is the integration point, not the resume ranking tool
- Calendar integrations (for interview scheduling notifications)
- Assessment platform integrations (if Rankora scores feed into assessment workflows)

**NOT Recommended:**
- Direct background check integrations (typically ATS-to-HRIS domain)
- HRIS/Payroll integrations (resume ranking happens pre-hire; HRIS is post-hire)
- Video interview platforms (separate domain)
